server.workflowChange.skills: The workflow changed: before the next judgment or action, re-match it against the skill targets and call every match now. A stage's provider is only the contract its result is recorded under; it does not limit the skills used, and another skill needs no plan change.
server.workflowChange.verification: Before first running a test, install or external tool in an environment, read that environment's guide and the script of its last successful run and set every condition the run needs at once. Before a full verification of a change to something many places read (fixed values, hashes, contracts, formats, public text), find its readers first and fix them in one pass. If failures keep changing under the same change, stop fixing one at a time and regroup the causes. Read every verification runner's result before reporting.
server.workflowChange.classification: Skill classification support is configured: before choosing skills for the next stage, pass its actual work and the full inventory to classify_skills for advice. Adopt, correct or reject the advice and make the final selection yourself; if the call fails, choose yourself and continue.
